title: Central Park and 5th Avenue Walking Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Take a tour seeing some of the best sights NYC has to offer! The Central Park & 5th Avenue tour will give you the chance to check some of the most iconic spots that all tourists love. Accompanied by an officially licensed tour guide, you’ll start with beautiful stroll through Central Park before entering into the heart of the Big Apple. We’ll give you the history of some of the most infamous locations around the city. Visit all the spots on your bucket list in just one 3 hour walking tour: Rockefeller Center, Radio City Music Hall, Grand Central Terminal, Central Park, and more!
